gate.note: The frozen protocol defines only this sample gate; it defines no numerical p-value or binary threshold, and none is invented here.

bound_snapshot.source_workflow: Prospective D4 Evidence Scheduler Bridge v1

hypothesis: higher local_range_to_spread_15s ranks higher subsequent volatility_expansion_ratio_60s (positive rank relationship)
conclusion_text: The frozen positive D4 rank relationship did not replicate directionally in the completed prospective sample: all 11 eligible clusters (3 UTC dates, 6 symbols each) show a negative median Spearman.
descriptive_context_not_preregistered: Under a null of symmetric cluster signs, 11/11 negative has a two-sided sign-test probability of about 0.001. Reported as context only; it was not a pre-registered decision rule.
scope: State-prediction experiment only; says nothing about strategy PnL.
consequences: Do not use the D4 relationship as a foundation for any strategy candidate.
Any reuse requires a completely new, independently specified hypothesis and version; the reversed sign observed here must not be adopted post hoc as a new hypothesis on this sample.
post_review_policy: This review is bound to the 11 cluster ids above. Clusters accumulated after this snapshot are reported as post-review accumulation and cannot revise this first formal conclusion.
